body: Source or scaffolding is decided case by case, by JayArr. Every time outside material — or material he supplies — arrives, prompt him for certainty: is it a source or scaffolding? Treat it as neither until he answers. No default in either direction. (2026-09-17 ruling, first worded as "a conversation outside this project is thinking scaffolding — not a source, not a run, not a record"; promoted 2026-10-03, JayArr: "You have to prompt me every time which is which, as it should be anyway" · "prompts for clarity." Clarified 2026-10-07, JayArr: "the scaffold ruling should be case by case basis meaning im prompted for certainty on whether its scaffolding or a source." The old first sentence set a default — outside = scaffolding — and that default is withdrawn. RULED. Resolves the §0a / cross-pollination contradiction the same way: neither default applies — ask.)
plain: Source or scaffolding is decided case by case: prompt JayArr every time material arrives, with no default either way.
